summary: PO 2020 section 8: compulsory advanced seminar (6 ECTS) and 6 ECTS additive key competencies, six 10-ECTS electives covering at least three of five areas, one application specialization of 18 ECTS, and the thesis.

categories.name: Six mathematics electives
categories.note: Six modules, 60 ECTS, from Analysis, Algebra, Diskrete Mathematik, Numerik and Stochastik. At least three of the five areas, and 10 to 30 ECTS in each area used; modules already taken in the Bachelor cannot be chosen. The area spread is not checked.

categories.name: One application specialization
categories.note: One specialization of 18 ECTS (PO section 3(2) and section 8(1)c). Study plans usually use three modules; in Nanostrukturwissenschaften, N01 (12 ECTS) plus one 6-ECTS module also reaches 18. ASP 3 Wirtschaftswissenschaften is in the PO but has no modules this semester.
